supplier_questions_ordered: Is this quote DDP (you pay US duty) or DDU/DAP (duty billed to us or the customer)?
What is the exact metal (304 stainless, other stainless grade, or chrome-plated carbon steel) used in the rack, since this changes both the tariff classification and the durability story?
What is the unit price for the dish rack at 1 unit, at 10 units, and at 50 units (state FOB or ex-works)?
What are the packed carton dimensions and weight for a single unit, given this item does not fold flat?
What is your processing/handling time before a tracked shipment is handed to the carrier?
What carrier and service do you use to a US address, and what is the stated transit time in days from handover to delivery?
Is end-to-end tracking provided to the US delivery address? Can you share a live tracking link for a recent shipment?
What is your return and defect policy for units damaged (e.g. bent wire) or lost in transit?
What is the minimum order quantity, and is there a price break at higher volumes beyond 50 units?
What adjustable-length and finish variants exist, and do any carry a different unit price or MOQ?
Will you send a single sample unit before a bulk order, what does the sample cost, and what is the sample lead time?

sample_recommendation.reasoning: ASSESSMENT: this product is the second-highest-value sample candidate, not the first. It combines the tightest cost ceiling with the worst shipping profile in this set, and its adjustable telescoping mechanism (durability, rigidity, fit against different sink widths) is exactly the kind of claim that desk research cannot resolve. If the owner can only fund one sample, start with the vacuum bags (cheaper, better odds); if a second sample is affordable, this is the one that most needs physical verification before committing to sourcing.
